body:
Reconstruct authenticated real coefficient sources and complete root/cell packets, then prove the original real sentence under one cumulative reflection budget and transaction.

The full algebraic example proves `∃ x : ℝ, x² − √2 ≥ 0 ∧ x² − √2 ≤ 0 ∧ 0 = 0`. Its coefficient identity now comes from descriptor/equation/window replay inside that same request, followed by polynomial reconstruction, complete cell replay and original-goal finishing. A fresh importing audit rejects the older imported source-selection and coefficient identities. The retained parent/model, original alias/coefficient-map laws and seed arithmetic facts remain explicit inputs.

The implementation provides:

- `SourceBuild.build`/`buildOn` propose selected source packets through existing owner enumeration or checked count-one open domains. They retain distinct production/descriptor failures, original equation/window keys and terminal refusal. Generic progress/acceptance laws use actual root coverage, no duplicate interpreted roots and codec/DAG laws; successful producer outputs are not progress hypotheses.
- `SourceIdentity.restorePacketWith`/`quotePacketWith` assemble the exact parent's codec/sign/signature, descriptor/header, prepared context and independent scalar readers. The retained checked header binds subsequent stored-coefficient interpretation to that same root. The original `quoteWith` interface remains compatible.
- `RowQuote`, `CellQuote.replayWith` and `finishPacketWith` preserve exact ordered roots/queries/cells, strict folds, the original target/divisor inventory and ordinary-kernel source equivalence. Preparation, authentication, replay and finishing share aggregate accounting and caller-state restoration.
- Proof admission shares a visited set within each check and discards it afterward. Raw/closed admission, unsafe rejection, exact targets, imported hidden-body inspection and fresh uncached kernel checking remain. Producer guards retain proof-only import boundaries.

Validation:

- [Joint source/goal record](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/76847445ff0c119cd8922beeb75ab1d7cae550e6/reports/data/hexrcf-joint-source-assembly/README.md): implementation `edd8c096424c6da1ee4f1ca02f7ea82cad32c3cc`, 145 bound sources/42 artifacts. Full request: 9,337,314 charged nodes, two graph-memo reuses/seven validations, complete standard-three axiom closure. Actual fresh audit: 1,191 theorem bodies/202 definitions/1,351 nonempty traces; prior source identities and all earlier fixtures/producers are forbidden. The unchanged original target is source-checked by the verifier.
- Seven-target integration passes 14,425 jobs with cached dependencies reused: optional umbrella, current source/bounded native controls, prior identity audits and complete manual. Runtime 8min8.376s, peak 5.5 GiB/no swap. The initial full source quote build passes in 13min45.873s, peak 2.3 GiB. The first fresh audit completed semantic/producer/body checks but rejected the old final inventory; its log/source are retained, and the new exact inventory passes without removing a guard.
- Compact source quotations retain positive/negative quadratic and cubic embeddings at 687,783/690,202/731,072 nodes, within default limits. Exact-budget success, 687,782-node refusal and four malformed descriptor/equation/coefficient-law/model cases check rollback. Actual fresh audit remains 392/449/811. Independent source identity remains 673,461 nodes with 218/179/385 fresh bodies/definitions/traces. Native controls retain all 25,477 bounded bytes, six graphs and previous conjugate/domain/ambiguity/refusal cases.
- Updated manual build/render pass; render 19.575s/2.2 GiB, browser 11.760s/3 GiB, no swap. All six 1440px/390px changed-paragraph captures were inspected with zero local overflow. Nine repository checks, source hashes, source-bound verifier, relative links and staged whitespace pass. This is the stated target selection, not the whole default conformance set or a new performance comparison.
- [Compiled numerical packet study](https://github.com/kim-em/hex-dev/blob/b842ec5cc39b32e8a68cd1754b06222d29b9eb05/reports/data/hexrcf-source-replay-dimensions/README.md): all 440 observations over 22 adapter-produced packets, five independent degree/query/bit/precision/depth axes and repeated/common-root cases. Four cumulative stages have 449 compiler imports/no Mathlib and 423 local source bindings. Exact hashes, operand/row/byte inventories, controls and memory scopes verify. Preparation/proofs are excluded; default native predecessor arithmetic remains. It establishes no strict all-depth replay or asymptotic timing law. Earlier proof and measurement records retain their original pins.

Every own Lean/Lake/benchmark/browser call is serial under a hard aggregate 32 GiB cap, zero swap and `LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2`. No AGENTS.md/PLAN.md edit, new axiom/admission, CI job, duplicate issue/PR, owner proof copy or downstream worker.

This remains partial implementation. Generic original-syntax/provider/predecessor/history discovery, complete automatic frontend/backend integration, overall accepted algebraic completeness, general joint realization, strict compiled missing/reached-record coverage and remaining API/manual/proof evidence are unfinished. Owner public-frame/general-export and presentation-model gates remain; #10377 root coverage/order exports already exist and are consumed. #10358 stays open, #10331 owns dispatch, and delivered #10633/#10634 work is preserved.

Required fresh Opus review hit the weekly quota at PR opening; this is not a completed review. Reported availability is October 19, 16:00 UTC. Keep draft pending actual review, addressed findings and final-head green. Merge with `gh pr merge --squash --auto` without `--delete-branch` when those gates pass.

Refs #10358, #10331
